scope: Exact F-MR24/F-MR21 two-module restart composition on F-CI24 canonical source; restricted serialized real-physics MultiSWAP restart only.

invariants.1_one_kernel: PASS: restart reconstructs the same canonical kernel committed-state abstraction; no second kernel.
invariants.2_kernel_io_separation: PASS: restart records are serialization-neutral; no file/path/parser calls in kernel or restart module.
invariants.3_explicit_data_separation: PASS: physical state, parameter_ref, template identity and continuation metadata remain distinct.
invariants.4_compact_persistent_state: PASS: immutable parameters/forcing are not embedded in restart state.
invariants.5_scratch_per_worker: PASS: no Newton/Jacobian/warm-start/worker scratch in restart records.
invariants.6_scalable_memory_layout: PASS: per-column record is compact and parameter data remains shared by reference.
invariants.7_transactional_timesteps: PASS: only committed state is exported; whole-registry restore is atomic and late failures leave targets unchanged.
invariants.8_cheap_recompute_warm_start: PASS: committed physical state is restored without conflating numerical trial guesses.
invariants.9_generic_time: PASS: qualification uses fractional generic times 4100.125, 4100.4375 and 4100.8125.
invariants.11_coupling_core_functionality: PASS: checkpoint/committed lineage semantics are preserved; no rollback contract weakened.
invariants.13_absolute_mass_conservation: PASS: exact interval mass continuation and continuous-vs-restarted endpoint identity pass.
invariants.16_multiswap_primary: PASS: matrix covers 1,2,7,8,17,31,32 logical columns and order changes.
invariants.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers: PASS: generic restart layer is concrete-physics-type agnostic; backend/state-family admission is isolated in runtime contract mapping.
invariants.21_reuse_swap_physics: PASS: no physics duplicated or rewritten.
invariants.22_no_headcalc_internal_coupling: PASS: restart code exposes no HeadCalc internal arrays.
invariants.23_physics_solver_policy_separation: PASS: state-family compatibility uses explicit backend and numerical-continuation layout identities, not hidden solver policy.
invariants.24_predictable_runtime: PASS: restart validation is bounded over records and does not add unbounded solve/retry work.
invariants.25_reference_mode_available: PASS: current canonical serialized reference runtime is preserved byte-for-byte.
invariants.26_runtime_diagnostics: PASS: current accepted-commit-receipt-aware serialized runtime and its diagnostics contract are preserved.
invariants.27_optional_functionality_scales_with_us: PASS: restart records exist only for restart use; no new state imposed on inactive functionality.
invariants.28_runtime_coupler_composition: PASS: restart ownership remains in runtime, outside kernel physics and external system topology.
invariants.29_no_silent_dependencies: PASS: exact source blobs, current canonical dependency blobs and accepted-commit-receipt API are hard source-locked in the gate.
invariants.30_explicit_architecture_review: PASS: this audit records all 30 invariants before any canonical promotion.

hard_holds: No canonical promotion before F-MR24 owner closeout or explicit governance supersession.
